scope: Windows isolated desktop, seven-file native packages. Untouched builds for 38-second ABBA entry trials. Timing probe overrides for deployment analysis; separate Vulkan and OpenGL Compatibility probes read actual texture pixels after mounting.

baseline_six_entry_thread_cpu.counter_scope: Samples bracket CPU usage but cannot establish the cause of the prior unmatched spike.

eviction_probe.scope: Same candidate package as the original test. The diagnostic launcher clears the eight retained textures in the menu before launching a non-Huangnigang battle. No production-script change was installed.

experiment_source_patch:

+# Keep only the eight opening props resident between Windows sorties.
+const HUANGNIGANG_OPENING_OBJECTS := [
+	"jujube_cart_01", "jujube_cart_02", "jujube_cart_03", "jujube_cart_04",
+	"jujube_cart_05", "jujube_cart_06", "jujube_cart_07", "jujube_load",
+]
+static var _huangnigang_opening_textures: Dictionary[String, Texture2D] = {}
+
 const OBJECT_ROUTES: Dictionary = {
 	"kuaihuolin_stall_inn_a": {"levels":["level7"],"paths":{"default":"res://assets/campaign/environment/level7/stall_inn_a.png"}},
 	"kuaihuolin_stall_wine": {"levels":["level7"],"paths":{"default":"res://assets/campaign/environment/level7/stall_wine.png"}},
@@ -936,7 +943,16 @@ static func _load_texture(path: String) -> Texture2D:
 
 static func object(active_level_id: String, route_key: String,
 		state: String = "default") -> Texture2D:
-	return _load_texture(_route_path(OBJECT_ROUTES, active_level_id, route_key, state))
+	var path := _route_path(OBJECT_ROUTES, active_level_id, route_key, state)
+	if path.is_empty() or OS.get_name() != "Windows" or active_level_id != "level1" \
+			or state != "default" or route_key not in HUANGNIGANG_OPENING_OBJECTS:
+		return _load_texture(path)
+	var texture: Texture2D = _huangnigang_opening_textures.get(path)
+	if texture == null:
+		texture = _load_texture(path)
+		if texture != null:
+			_huangnigang_opening_textures[path] = texture
+	return texture
